shortDescription: The DAX Index dropped 131 points or 0.50 percent on Wednesday to close at 25839 points.Losses were led by Zalando (-5.21%), Volkswagen (-3.83%) and Porsche Automobil (-3.39%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Qiagen NV (2.31%), Commerzbank (1.70%) and Rheinmetall (1.20%).

children: The DAX Index dropped 131 points or 0.50 percent on Wednesday to close at 25839 points.
Losses were led by Zalando (-5.21%), Volkswagen (-3.83%) and Porsche Automobil (-3.39%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Qiagen NV (2.31%), Commerzbank (1.70%) and Rheinmetall (1.20%).

title: The DAX Index Closes 0.50% Lower
